svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xJe5HL-tUzzX3A5tEd4K"> <mxGraphModel dx="7357" dy="3764" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Operator as Main / Operator
 participant C as colony : Colony
 participant E as leak : OxygenLeak
 participant H as affectedHabitat : Habitat
 participant Eng as humanRepairer : Engineer
 participant Bot as robotRepairer : RepairRobot

 Operator->>C: triggerEmergency(leak)
 activate C
 C->>C: emergencyHistory.add(leak)
 C->>E: handle(this)
 activate E

 E->>E: setEmergencyState(TRIGGERED)
 E->>H: deductResource(OXYGEN, 50)
 H-->>E: 50 deducted

 E->>C: getAgents()
 loop Polymorphic Responder Search
 E->>Eng: isAvailable() & !isOnMission() & canHandle(EQUIPMENT_REPAIR) & isHuman()
 Eng-->>E: true
 E->>Bot: isAvailable() & !isOnMission() & canHandle(EQUIPMENT_REPAIR) & isRobot()
 Bot-->>E: true
 end

 alt Responders Available
 E->>C: getTotalResource(SPARE_PARTS) >= 2 & getTotalResource(BATTERY_POWER) >= 5
 C-->>E: resourcesSufficient

 alt Resources Sufficient (Resolved Flow)
 E->>Eng: setLocation(affectedHabitat.getLocation())
 E->>Bot: setLocation(affectedHabitat.getLocation())
 E->>C: deductResource(SPARE_PARTS, 2)
 E->>C: deductResource(BATTERY_POWER, 5)
 E->>H: setOperationalStatus(true)
 E->>E: setEmergencyState(RESOLVED)
 E-->>C: true
 else Insufficient Resources (Unresolved Flow)
 E->>E: setEmergencyState(UNRESOLVED)
 E->>E: setFailureReason(\"Insufficient response resources...\")
 E->>H: deductResource(OXYGEN, 50)
 Note over E,H: Double oxygen loss penalty applied (100 total)
 E-->>C: false
 end
 else Responders Unavailable (Unresolved Flow)
 E->>E: setEmergencyState(UNRESOLVED)
 E->>E: setFailureReason(\"Required responders unavailable...\")
 E->>H: deductResource(OXYGEN, 50)
 Note over E,H: Double oxygen loss penalty applied (100 total)
 E-->>C: false
 end

 deactivate E
 C-->>Operator: outcome (boolean)
 deactivate C",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
